signal: Funnel hit $50M ARR faster than any multifamily software company and closed a $36.5M Series B, with ZRS selecting it across a 110,000-unit portfolio.

email.body1:
Rahul, saw Funnel just became the fastest multifamily software company to $50M ARR and landed ZRS across 110,000 units.

Growth that steep usually means more in-market operators in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Funnel off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Rahul, quick follow-up for Funnel.

Post-raise and post-$50M, board expectations on pipeline tend to outrun what headcount can absorb. As a revenue ops lead you feel the signal-to-action latency first: in-market accounts that never get a timely touch.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Funnel needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Rahul, last bit of proof for Funnel.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Funnel's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Rahul, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action and scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Hitting $50M that fast means a lot of competing fires.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I will tailor it to Funnel either way.
